title: Miss Mowchow after he became a professional
summary: Basie says she put up with him, scolded him when he returned to play in Red Bank, and called him Willie.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers

blocks.x: Did you get along with her, Miss Mowchow?
Or did you give her a tough time?
I mean, I somehow can't imagine that you would make it easy for her.
Did she ever -- did she know you after -- that is, once you'd become, you know, a professional musician, was she --

Do you remember what she said?
Yeah, I'm saving that one, just a little joke, you know?
